## Production artifact provenance

The table describes the recorded environment that generated the condition
artifacts, not merely the environment used to render this report.

```{r production-provenance}
metadata_files <- list.files(
  output_dir,
  pattern = "_run_metadata[.]csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)
if (length(metadata_files) == 0L) {
  stop("No production run metadata found in: ", output_dir)
}
metadata <- data.table::rbindlist(
  lapply(metadata_files, data.table::fread),
  fill = TRUE,
  use.names = TRUE
) %>%
  tibble::as_tibble() %>%
  filter(
    .data$condition_id_end >= min(expected_ids),
    .data$condition_id_start <= max(expected_ids)
  )
metadata_condition_ids <- unique(unlist(Map(
  seq.int,
  metadata$condition_id_start,
  metadata$condition_id_end
)))
missing_metadata_ids <- setdiff(expected_ids, metadata_condition_ids)
if (nrow(metadata) == 0L || length(missing_metadata_ids) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Production metadata do not cover ", length(missing_metadata_ids),
    " expected condition IDs."
  )
}

metadata %>%
  distinct(
    .data$pipeline_version, .data$git_commit, .data$git_dirty,
    .data$requested_n_sim, .data$r_version, .data$mplus_version,
    .data$package_openmx_version,
    .data$package_mplusautomation_version, .data$package_lme4_version
  ) %>%
  kable(
    col.names = c(
      "Pipeline", "Git commit", "Dirty worktree", "Requested replications",
      "R", "Mplus", "OpenMx", "MplusAutomation", "lme4"
    ),
    caption = paste(
      "Distinct production environments recorded for condition IDs",
      paste(range(expected_ids), collapse = "--"),
      sprintf("(%s metadata files).", nrow(metadata))
    )
  )
```

`r if (any(metadata$git_dirty %in% TRUE)) "**Reproducibility note.** The production metadata record a dirty worktree. The commit hashes are therefore base references, not complete snapshots of the source that generated every artifact. The artifact-level v2, method, replication, and design contracts above still protect this report from legacy or structurally incompatible inputs, but a publication freeze should regenerate the final archive from a clean, tagged commit." else "All production runs in this artifact set record a clean Git worktree."`
